dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a moderately concave curvature from the midpoint of the fin transitioning into a sharper recurve toward the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Apex is characterized by a small-radius rounded profile forming an acute transition between the leading and trailing edges.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin contour presents a steep, slightly convex slope at approximately 48 degrees relative to the visible horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The fin exhibits a vertical-dominant profile with a height-to-base ratio of approximately 1.25:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible faint vertical and diagonal linear rake marks on the lower right flank area of the torso below the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Minor irregular nicks and small crenulations are present along the lower one-third of the trailing edge boundary.
